title: AI Capability Gateway — Capability Manifest v1
description: JSON Schema 2020-12 definition for the AI Capability Gateway Capability Manifest. Covers Sections 6.2–6.7, 6.5.1, 6.9, 10.1, 10.5, 12.3, 12.5 and 13.1 of the design document. This schema is the machine-checkable contract for Manifest import and validation (Section 8.2 step 1).
$comment: Cross-field constraints that JSON Schema cannot express (e.g. parameterTypes/arguments positional correspondence, projection target uniqueness, redaction path existence within publicSchema) are enforced by the Contract Validator (Section 8.2).

jsonPointer.description: A non-empty JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) starting with '/'.

converterWhitelist.description: Built-in converter whitelist (Section 6.5.1). New converters are not accepted via Manifest; changes follow platform release process.

systemSourcePathWhitelist.description: SYSTEM source can only read platform built-in whitelist paths (Section 6.5). Manifest cannot declare new system variables.

id.description: Globally stable capability ID, e.g. order.detail.query. Only lowercase letters, digits, dots and hyphens (Section 6.3).

tags.description: Optional controlled tags for retrieval and governance (Section 6.2).

risk.description: Risk level determining execution control strength (Section 6.2). READ_ONLY: direct execution. WRITE_LOW: Prepare/Confirm required. WRITE_HIGH: prohibited until independent security review and dual approval (Section 13.1).

positive.description: At least three natural-language positive examples (Section 6.8).

negative.description: At least two easily-confused negative examples, indicating which other capability to choose or no match (Section 6.8).

synonyms.description: Key noun synonyms for retrieval disambiguation (Section 6.8).

additionalProperties.description: Must be explicitly false to prevent mass assignment (Section 6.4).

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 for model-visible business parameters only. Must not contain orgId, tenantId, userId, roles, service addresses or interface names (Section 6.4). Only MODEL-sourced parameters appear here.

items.description: Permission string in domain:resource:action[:scope] format (Section 10.5). Wildcards are prohibited.

permissions.description: Required permission strings. Orthogonal to risk: permissions determine 'can call', risk determines 'control strength' (Section 10.5).

principalClaims.description: Required Principal claims keyed by JSON Pointer, e.g. /orgId (Section 6.2, 10.1).

maxAuthAgeSeconds.description: Maximum authentication age in seconds for write operations. Confirm must re-check auth freshness (Section 10.1).

requiredAmr.description: Required Authentication Method References, e.g. MFA level (Section 10.1).

authorization.description: Optional authorization requirements (Section 6.2). Shelved in first phase; all authenticated users can call published READ_ONLY capabilities (Section 10.2).

type.description: Expected JSON type of the Principal claim.

required.description: Whether the claim must be present on the Principal.

value.description: Constant value for CONSTANT source. Type must be compatible with target field.

allOf.$comment: SYSTEM source must reference a whitelisted platform path.
MODEL and PRINCIPAL sources require a sourcePath to read from.

fieldBinding.description: A single source-to-target field binding used in composite argument objects and attachment bindings (Section 6.5). Converter operates on a single source value to a single target field; cross-field composition is not supported (Section 6.5.1).

position.description: Zero-based protocol parameter position. Must be unique and continuous across arguments; must match parameterTypes (Section 6.5).

protocolType.description: Java fully-qualified type name for protocol invocation, e.g. java.lang.Long or com.example.order.api.OrderQueryRequest.

value.description: Constant value for CONSTANT source (simple binding only).

object.description: Composite binding: JSON Pointer to FieldBinding map (Section 6.5). A DTO mixing business and trusted fields must use this. Reserved fields like /class, /@type are rejected by the binder.

oneOf.title: Simple argument binding
oneOf.description: Simple binding: single source to a single protocol parameter.

oneOf.title: Composite argument binding
oneOf.description: Composite binding: JSON Pointer map for DTO with mixed source fields.

allOf.$comment: Simple binding: CONSTANT source requires value.
Simple binding: SYSTEM source must reference a whitelisted platform path.
Simple binding: MODEL and PRINCIPAL sources require a sourcePath.

argumentBinding.description: Protocol argument binding — either simple (source-based) or composite (object map). Exactly one binding mode per argument (Section 6.5).

protocol.description: Protocol type (Section 6.6). First phase: DUBBO only.

registryRef.description: Reference to an operationally pre-configured registry. Manifest must not carry usernames, passwords or arbitrary registry addresses (Section 6.6). Required when protocol is DUBBO.

interfaceName.description: Fully-qualified interface name. Used as protocol metadata string only; not loaded at runtime (Section 6.6).

method.description: Method name. Overloaded methods are located by the full parameter type list (Section 12.1).

parameterTypes.description: Protocol parameter type names. Must correspond one-to-one with arguments by position and protocolType (Section 6.6).

serialization.description: Serialization from the platform whitelist. Only Apache Dubbo community built-in implementations are accepted (Section 12.3). Must match Provider prefer-serialization; negotiation result is固化d in compatibility testing.

propertyNames.description: Attachment keys must be in the platform whitelist (Section 12.5). Unsigned tenant, user or permission attachments are not allowed.

attachments.description: Attachment bindings. Attachments only carry non-authorisation context (Trace ID, deadline, Locale, signed delegated token, observability keys). They never participate in authorisation (Section 12.5).

invocation.description: Protocol binding and deterministic argument mapping. Does not enter model context (Section 6.6).

mode.description: Response unwrapping mode (Section 6.7). ENVELOPE: declare codePath/successValues/dataPath. DIRECT: protocol return root is data, must not declare success code path.

projection.description: JSON Pointer whitelist projection from Provider data to public data. Unmapped fields do not leave the gateway (Section 6.7). If absent, extracted data must match publicSchema exactly.

redactions.description: Field redaction rules applied after projection and before publicSchema validation (Section 6.7, 11.3).

maxBytes.description: Maximum response size in bytes (Section 6.7). Default 256 KiB.

allOf.$comment: DIRECT mode must not declare envelope (success code path).

output.description: Response contract: unwrapping, projection, public schema, redaction and size limit (Section 6.7). Provider return is converted to neutral JSON tree before processing; protocol metadata keys (class, @type) are recursively stripped (Section 12.1).

codePath.description: JSON Pointer to the business success code field.

successValues.description: Success code values. JSON scalars compared exactly: number 0 and string "0" are distinct values (Section 6.7).

dataPath.description: JSON Pointer to the data payload field.

messagePath.description: Optional JSON Pointer to the message field.

envelope.description: Envelope specification for ENVELOPE mode (Section 6.7). Platform standard档: code is string "200", data path is /value.

from.description: Source JSON Pointer in Provider data.

to.description: Target JSON Pointer in public data.

path.description: JSON Pointer to the field to redact in the projected result.

method.description: Redaction method: DELETE removes the field, PARTIAL_MASK masks part of the value, HASH replaces with irreversible hash (Section 11.3).

publicSchema.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 for the public output after projection and redaction (Section 6.7). Validated after redaction; failure blocks result return.

timeoutMs.description: Provider call timeout in milliseconds (Section 6.9). Actual timeout is the minimum of Manifest value, platform cap and入口 remaining deadline (Section 12.4).

retries.description: Maximum retry count for transient network errors only (Section 6.9). Read-only defaults to at most 1; write operations default to 0 unless Provider-verifiable idempotency key is present (Section 12.4).

maxConcurrent.description: Maximum concurrent invocations per capability for bulkhead isolation (Section 6.9).

resilience.description: Resilience settings: timeout, retries, concurrency and size limits (Section 6.9).
